facts.label: Surahs
facts.note: Consensus; a minority view counts al-Anfal and al-Bara'ah (8-9) as one surah, giving 113 (al-Suyuti, al-Itqan, via SeekersGuidance).
facts.source: Al-Suyuti, al-Itqan fi Ulum al-Quran; Shaykh Anas al-Musa, SeekersGuidance

facts.label: Verses (ayahs)
facts.note: Kufi count, used in the standard Madinan mushaf; Basri 6,204, Madani 6,214 / 6,217, Shami 6,226 - same text, different verse divisions.
facts.source: Al-Suyuti, al-Itqan fi Ulum al-Quran (quoting Abu Amr al-Dani); Shaykh Anas al-Musa, SeekersGuidance; verified by script on QAC v0.4 and the Tanzil text

facts.label: Meccan / Medinan surahs
facts.note: Standard classification by time of revelation relative to the Hijra; classical reports differ - al-Suyuti reports 83 Meccan / 31 Medinan and 85 / 29 variants, so the split is approximate, not exact.
facts.source: IslamWeb fatwa 343273, citing al-Suyuti, al-Itqan fi Ulum al-Quran

facts.label: Revelation period
facts.note: 13 years in Mecca + 10 in Medina (Sahih al-Bukhari 3902); another report (Bukhari 4979) counts 10 + 10, reconciled by scholars as excluding the pause in revelation (fatrat al-wahy).

facts.label: First revelation
facts.note: Surah al-Alaq, 'Read in the name of your Lord who created...', in the cave of Hira; a minority view names al-Muddaththir (74:1-5) as first (noted by Ibn Hajar, Fath al-Bari).

facts.label: Night revelation began
facts.note: Quran 97:1 and 2:185; Ibn Kathir's Tafsir on 97:1: the Quran was sent down to the lowest heaven on Laylat al-Qadr, then came down in parts over 23 years.
facts.source: Quran 97:1; Quran 2:185; Tafsir Ibn Kathir on 97:1

facts.label: Juz / Hizb
facts.note: Later scholarly division for recitation, traced to the era of al-Hajjaj ibn Yusuf (Ibn Taymiyyah, Majmu al-Fatawa 13/409-410), not part of the revelation itself; each juz = 2 hizb.
facts.source: Ibn Taymiyyah, Majmu al-Fatawa 13/409-410; al-Suyuti, al-Itqan fi Ulum al-Quran

facts.label: Longest surah
facts.source: Tanzil Uthmani text (script count); standard Kufi verse table

facts.label: Shortest surah
facts.note: Tied with Al-Asr (103) and An-Nasr (110), also 3 verses each.
facts.source: Tanzil Uthmani text (script count); standard Kufi verse table

facts.label: Surahs opening with the Basmalah
facts.note: Every surah except At-Tawbah (9); total Basmalah occurrences 114, including the one inside verse 27:30.
